name: cua-mac
description: Control macOS apps through Accessibility, ScreenCaptureKit, and native input.

interface.shortDescription: Observe and operate Mac apps with native mouse and keyboard control.
interface.longDescription: Uses macOS Accessibility for semantic control, ScreenCaptureKit for observation, and CGEvent for automatic mouse and keyboard fallback.
